turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. My son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first: who decided that, and was Owen heard before it went in?
I'm waiting, Hale. Was Owen heard before the zero went in, yes or no?
The file was created at 11:31 PM and the first 612 words appeared at 11:52 PM.

11:31 PM and 11:52 PM on what date, from what record, and is it in front of you right now? Turn the screen so I can read it myself. And you still haven't answered me: was Owen heard before the zero went in?
512. A minute ago it was 612, and I'm writing down that you corrected yourself. Show me the record, Hale, because I'm not taking numbers from memory.
How many different numbers have I given you, and how many minutes was the gap?
You said 11:31 PM, 11:52 PM, 612, then 512, and I'm not doing your arithmetic for you. Your numbers, your job. Put the document in front of me or tell me what else you have.
